text:
incident-bot: P1 -> inference-runtime: elevated 5xx errors and OOM kills on pool-alpha. Paging oncall. root_ts=1793000123

lena: taking this. summary: multiple inference-worker pods OOMing in us-east-1 -> controller evicting and causing cascading retries. visible error pattern: `runtime: out of memory` in pod logs, error rate ~3.7% on /v1/chat.

chen: i'm secondary for the shift. quick question: any recent deploys?

lena: small rollout of 2.4.1 (kv-cache changes) went at ~08:10 UTC. I pinned rollback candidate already.

rachel: runbook link: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/ooms-and-evictions. follow the emergency steps under "immediate stabilization".

lena: what i've done so far:
- cordoned nodes with repeated evictions to avoid scheduling new pods there
- set HPA minReplicas +2 on pool-alpha to keep pods up during node churn
- temporarily reduce max_tokens limit at gateway for affected customer-routes to 512
- disabled the new KV prefetch feature via config flag `kv_prefetch=false`

lena: commands I ran:
```
kubectl get pods -n prod -l pool=pool-alpha -o jsonpath='{.items[*].metadata.name}'
kubectl logs pod/inference-xyz -n prod --tail=200 | grep -i oom
kubectl cordon ip-10-2-45-11
kubectl scale deploy/inference-pool-alpha --replicas=6 -n prod
```

jordi: logs show repeated mem spike at ~2.8Gi before OOM. suspect a memory regression in 2.4.1 when handling long context caching.

devops-bot: infra: three nodes in asg-alpha reported memory pressure; one node marked NotReady and drained. autoscaling did not spin up replacement quickly due to cooldown.

lena: mitigation plan: 1) revert 2.4.1 rollout for pool-alpha -> coordinated rollback (non-urgent canary rollback). 2) enable emergency eviction-safety config in runtime (`runtime.eviction_safety=true`) to avoid full retries. 3) request fast replace of drained node.

chen: i'll initiate the rollback now and watch for regressions. ping me if anything blocks. I'll also open a short-term exemption to allow HPA to scale to 8 replicas.

(6m later)

chen: rollback applied to pool-alpha -> rolling back to 2.4.0. New pods scheduling. seeing lower memory footprints on the new pods.

lena: good. monitoring error rate: 5xx down from 3.7% -> 0.9% over 4m. still watching for retries/backpressure.

rachel: customer impact note: support-bot flagged 23 customer complaints in the last 90 minutes, highest impact: ProtoHealth and Skybox Analytics (both on heavy long-context workloads). Support and CSMs notified.

support-bot: customer-impact: ~0.6% of requests failed with 5xx during incident window. Estimated start 2026-04-02T08:07:00Z, partial recovery at ~2026-04-02T08:23:00Z.

lena: coverage gap: chen has a planned break 15:00-16:30 UTC tonight (no secondary in that window). need someone to cover 15:00-16:30 UTC. I'm primary until 2026-04-03T09:00:00Z.

jordi: i can cover 15:30-16:00 UTC but not full window. rachel can you take the 15:00-16:30?

rachel: i can pick up 15:00-16:30 UTC. updating rota.

lena: filing incident ticket and retro: INC-2048 created (https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2048). Please add notes for reproducer.

chen: action items (capture in ticket):
- AI-1: revert gating/tests for kv cache prefetch in CI and add mem-smoke test for long-context patterns (owner: chen)
- AI-2: improve autoscaler cooldown behavior to scale faster on node NotReady events (owner: jordi)
- AI-3: add a runtime metric alert for mem-usage > 85% for 5m for pool-alpha (owner: rachel)
- AI-4: document emergency gateway override to reduce max_tokens and how to apply it (owner: lena)

rachel: I've scheduled a postmortem: Fri Apr 4 14:00 UTC. Invite sent to eng-oncall, eng-runtime, and product reliability.

lena: post-handoff: primary -> lena until 2026-04-03T09:00:00Z, secondary -> rachel for 15:00-16:30 UTC coverage. Handoff note: check node health, HPA target, and mem-usage metric `runtime_pool_alpha_mem_p95` in the console.

chen: leaving a snippet for whoever picks this later:
```
# quick checks
curl -sS https://internal-metrics/api/v1/query?query=runtime_pool_alpha_mem_p95
kubectl get nodes -o wide | grep NotReady
kubectl describe pod inference-abc -n prod | grep -i 'OOMKilled\|Evicted'
```

lena: follow-ups: link INC-2048 to customer advisory draft (support will finalize by EOD). please ensure AI owners update the ticket before retro.

devops-bot: automated-page closed (status: mitigated).

lena: thanks everyone. leaving this thread linked in INC-2048. ping if regression. :raised_hands:
